name: @sauce/router
description: SauceScript swap library: one function per venue, taking run-time arguments and returning the amount received. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (router.evm.js, router.svm.js); there is no router.js, because no venue is on both targets: the EVM arm's venues are EVM contracts and the SVM arm's Solana programs, so a function one arm lacks fails at its import, naming it, instead of compiling something wrong.
